info.name: TechnoStore SAP Demo (7 Phases)
info.description:
Tek tıkla demo: 7 SAP entegrasyon fazının gerçek API çağrıları. Tüm istekler **sandbox.api.sap.com** (SAP API Hub Sandbox — gerçek SAP altyapısı) hedefini kullanır.

**Honest demo notu**: Her istek **gerçek SAP altyapısına** gider, gerçek response döner. Sandbox read-mostly modunda olduğu için POST'lar (Phase 2) 200 dönse de persist etmez — bu transparent davranış audit field'larda görünür (`Status_In_SAP__c=Push Failed`).

Demo recording'de her phase için:
1. `Send` butonuna tıkla
2. Real request / response paneline bak
3. Aynı çağrı Salesforce Apex'ten de yapılıyor (split-screen)

Environment **TechnoStore SAP Demo Env** aktif olmalı. `SAP_API_KEY` değerini SAP API Hub hesabınızdan alın (gitignored değil — placeholder).

item.name: Phase 1 — ATP Check (Material Stock)
item.description: GET available stock for a material from SAP MM. Apex servisi: `SapMaterialStockService.checkOrderStock()`. ADR-022.

header.description: SAP API Hub gzip quirk — explicit identity prevents binary response

request.description: Material 221 için available stock. Sandbox tipik response: 0.000 units (read-only sample data).

exec: pm.test('200 OK from SAP MM', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
console.log('SAP returned ' + results.length + ' stock record(s) for Material 221');

item.name: Phase 2 — Sales Order Push (CSRF + POST)
item.description: Two-step: HEAD for CSRF token, then POST Sales Order. Apex servisi: `SapSalesOrderService.pushOrders()` (@future). ADR-023. **Honest note**: Sandbox POST 200 dönse de persist etmez — bu transparent davranış demo'da gösterilir.

request.description: SAP CSRF protection: önce token al, sonra POST'ta header'a koy.

exec: console.warn('No CSRF token in response — Step 2 may fail');

request.description: Sales Order header + 1 item. Silverstar Corp. (17100001) için, TS-DEMO-001 reference.

exec: console.log('Sandbox POST may return 200 without persisting (read-mostly behavior) — see ADR-023 for production migration.');

item.name: Phase 3 — Tax Determination
item.description: POST to SAP tax engine. Sandbox response: license-gated (403) — code transparently falls back to country table. Apex servisi: `SapTaxCalculationService.calculateInvoiceTax()`. ADR-024.

request.description: DE 19% VAT calc. **Honest expectation**: license-gated 403 — code path falls back to local 19% DE rate table. `Tax_Engine_Used__c` field on Invoice records which engine was used.

exec: console.log('Expected sandbox behavior: license-gated. Apex falls back to country table (DE=19%). See ADR-024.');

item.name: Phase 4 — Payment Reconciliation (CAMT.053 — local parsing)
item.description:
**Not a SAP API call** — CAMT.053 ISO 20022 bank statement XML is parsed locally by `SapPaymentReconciliationService.parseCamt053()`. ADR-025.

Demo'da Apex tarafında gösterilir (no Postman request). Bu folder dokümantasyon için var.

item.name: (See Apex SapPaymentReconciliationService for CAMT.053 parsing demo)

request.description: Placeholder. Real demo: anonymous Apex `scripts/test_sap_payment_reconciliation.apex` parses sample CAMT.053 XML, matches transactions to Invoices via 3-rule cascade (EndToEndId → Remittance Reference → Amount Tolerance ±0.50 EUR).

item.name: Phase 5 — Material Master Sync (Product GET)
item.description: GET products from SAP, upsert to SF Product2 by SAP_Material_Number__c. Apex servisi: `SapMaterialMasterSyncService.syncMaterialMaster()`. ADR-026.

request.description: Tüm SAP material master'lardan ilk 10. Sandbox sample: 10 record. Demo'da Apex aynı GET'i yapıyor → Product2 upsert.

exec: pm.test('200 OK from SAP API_PRODUCT_SRV', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));

item.name: Phase 6 — Customer Master Sync (Business Partner GET)
item.description:
GET Business Partners (organizations) from SAP, upsert to SF Account by SAP_BP_Number__c. Apex servisi: `SapCustomerMasterSyncService.syncCustomerMaster()`. ADR-027.

**Demo highlight**: Sample BPs include real German enterprises (Bechtle AG, Inlandskunde DE) — DACH market signal.

request.description: Sandbox sample includes Bechtle AG, Inlandskunde DE — gerçek Alman kurumları. Filter: BusinessPartnerCategory='2' = Organization (sadece B2B).

exec: pm.test('200 OK from SAP API_BUSINESS_PARTNER', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
bps.slice(0, 5).forEach(b => console.log('  - BP ' + b.BusinessPartner + ': ' + b.BusinessPartnerFullName + ' (Grp=' + b.BusinessPartnerGrouping + ')'));

item.name: Phase 7 — Event Mesh Inbound (CloudEvents Webhook)
item.description:
**Direction reversed**: SAP → Salesforce. Postman simulates SAP Event Mesh publishing a CloudEvent to the Salesforce Apex REST webhook `/services/apexrest/sap/event`.

Auth: Salesforce session bearer token ({{SF_ACCESS_TOKEN}}) + HMAC X-SAP-Secret ({{SAP_WEBHOOK_SECRET}}, from Inventory_Integration_Config__mdt.Default.Shared_Secret__c). Set {{SF_INSTANCE_URL}} to your org's my.salesforce.com URL.

Apex handler: `SapEventWebhook.handle()` + `SapInboundEventDispatcher.route()`. ADR-028. Verified: POST returns 200 `Event ... dispatched.` and the dispatcher updates the matching Account/Order/Product2/Invoice audit field.

**Honest note**: SAP Event Mesh itself requires SAP BTP (separate trial — not enabled). Postman replicates the exact CloudEvents 1.0 contract that production SAP Event Mesh would POST to this same endpoint.

header.description: Salesforce session bearer token (sf org display)

request.description: SAP BP grouping değişti event'i. Dispatcher Account.SAP_Customer_Group__c'yi BP02'ye günceller.

item.name: Architecture & Honest Caveats
item.description: Demo recording'de recruiter'a açıklanan mimari kararlar ve transparent kısıtlamalar.

request.description:
## TechnoStore SAP Demo — Architecture

**Target**: `sandbox.api.sap.com` (SAP API Hub Sandbox — gerçek SAP altyapısı, public test endpoint).

**Trial Tenant**: `my429998.s4hana.cloud.sap` (SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition Trial — Communication Arrangements **trial'da kısıtlı** olduğu için Apex kodumuz buraya direkt yazamıyor).

**Why this matters**:
- Production migration: SAP_Config__c.API_Base_URL__c değeri sandbox URL'inden gerçek tenant URL'ine değişir + OAuth Communication Arrangement kurulur (ADR-029)
- Apex contract aynı kalır → zero code change
- Trial Fiori screenshots **sadece production UI referansı** olarak gösterilir, **kod entegrasyonu kanıtı değil**

**Phase 2 — Sandbox POST honest behavior**: Sandbox POST 200 dönse de persist etmez → `Status_In_SAP__c=Push Failed` doğru audit field değeri. Production'da gerçek SO numarası döner ve `SAP_Sales_Order_Number__c`'ye yazılır.

**Phase 3 — Tax engine license gating**: Sandbox tax modülü 403/license-gated → `Tax_Engine_Used__c=SAP_FALLBACK_TABLE` (kod transparent fallback). Production'da licensed tax module aktifse `SAP_API`.

**Phase 7 — Event Mesh**: SAP BTP servisi, trial'da yok. Postman aynı CloudEvents 1.0 contract'ı kullanır → integration code yine production-ready.

**Tüm ADR'ler**: `docs/adr/ADR-022` … `ADR-028` (per-phase), `ADR-029` (production migration path).
